summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review comments on the phase-39 branch (user-configurable vault parameters), keep the branch current with main, and maintain code quality.
summary.outcome: All 15+ review threads across 4 review rounds were triaged and resolved; fixes included allowing 0-day retention, TEE IPNS key enrollment, setTimeout cleanup, new unit tests, bin store dead-code removal, validation defaults referencing canonical constants, and docs updates. Branch was merged with main and a poisoned axios version was pinned.

repo: cipher-box is a pnpm monorepo with workspaces: packages/core, packages/crypto, apps/web, apps/desktop, apps/tee-worker
Phase planning docs live in .planning/phases/<n>-<name>/ with CONTEXT, RESEARCH, VALIDATION, and SUMMARY markdown files that must be kept in sync with implementation
The BYO (bring-your-own) config pattern in StorageTab is the canonical reference for how IPNS keypair derivation + TEE enrollment should work in service layer code
recycleBinRetentionDays: 0 is intentionally valid (means immediate purge / disabled retention) per Phase 39 D-03 requirement
vault-settings.service.ts uses deriveVaultSettingsIpnsKeypair to load/save settings via IPNS; TEE enrollment must wrap the IPNS key before publishing
The pnpm lockfile formatting (inline vs expanded YAML blocks) differs between branches due to pnpm version differences at time of install, causing large cosmetic diffs on merge
commit 560c871fe on phase-38 branch removed an @cipherbox/core circular import from vault-ipns.test.ts that had not yet been merged to phase-39 branch
DEFAULT_VAULT_SETTINGS in packages/core/src/vault/settings.ts is the single source of truth for default values; validators should reference it rather than duplicating literals

code.finding: validateVaultSettings was using hardcoded literals (30, 10, 15, 'bin') instead of DEFAULT_VAULT_SETTINGS fields; also unknown schema versions were silently coerced to v1 instead of returning defaults
JSDoc for recycleBinRetentionDays said range 1-365; corrected to 0-365
retentionDays now sourced from useVaultSettingsStore, making useBinStore.retentionDays field and setRetentionDays setter dead code (removed)
retentionDays field and setRetentionDays setter were write-only dead code after useBin.ts was updated; fully removed
setTimeout without cleanup caused a leak on unmount; fixed using useRef + useEffect cleanup
saveVaultSettings was missing TEE IPNS key enrollment; pattern from StorageTab (BYO config) was the reference

Variable named prunedVersions actually held the kept versions (slice(0, maxVer)), not the pruned ones — misleading name, renamed to keptVersions. JSDoc also still referenced hardcoded VERSION_COOLDOWN_MS instead of configurable getVersionCooldownMs()

Pre-existing circular import of @cipherbox/core caused test file to fail; fixed inline using test vectors instead. New deriveVaultSettingsIpnsKeypair tests placed in separate vault-settings-ipns.test.ts file
Test 'should clamp recycleBinRetentionDays below 1 to 1' was asserting old min=1 behavior; updated to expect 0 and renamed to reflect that 0 is valid

workflow: When merging main into a feature branch via git merge, resolve lockfile conflicts by running pnpm install after to regenerate canonical format
Background task race condition: running git push manually after launching a background commit+push task causes the background push to fail with 'already up to date' — harmless but noisy

The resolve-PR-comments workflow: triage first (valid/already-addressed/not-applicable), verify against current code before implementing, run typecheck + tests before committing, then reply and resolve threads via REST + GraphQL
Copilot review comments often lag behind commits on the same PR — always verify findings against current code state before acting on them
For axios supply-chain poisoning incident: pinning without caret (1.13.2 vs ^1.13.2) in lockfile is the fix; the diff is minimal and safe to push quickly

friction: pnpm lockfile YAML formatting churn (15k lines) from branch/main merge made it hard to identify real content changes; had to grep specifically for axios to find the only substantive diff
Background task push raced with foreground git push, causing a confusing exit code 1 failure from the background task even though everything was already pushed
vault-ipns.test.ts had a pre-existing circular import bug (@cipherbox/core) that was fixed on phase-38 but not merged to phase-39, blocking new tests from running in the existing file
User interrupted a commit operation mid-flow, then ran pnpm lint:fix manually, requiring re-checking what changed before continuing
Multiple rounds of Copilot review comments on the same already-fixed issues (setRetentionDays, JSDoc range) because Copilot reviewed before fixes landed
open_items: Keypair (privateKey buffer) clearing after use in vault-settings.service.ts was flagged by review but skipped — BYO config reference impl also doesn't clear it; acceptable for now but worth revisiting if threat model changes
VaultTab.tsx preset retention values (thread 5) were marked not-applicable as a deliberate design simplification — presets may be added in a future phase
Desktop client and other non-web consumers still call the recyclebin purge API endpoint that was noted as potentially redundant for web — left intact since other clients depend on it
The pnpm lockfile YAML formatting inconsistency between branches (inline vs expanded) will recur on future merges until all branches are rebased on the same pnpm version base
